seo.title: Best Natural Wine Bars in Amsterdam (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Amsterdam's top 12 natural wine bars for 2026! From cozy hidden gems to vibrant hotspots, find your perfect spot for biodynamic, organic, and unfiltered wines.

hero.h1: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Amsterdam
hero.subtitle: Amsterdam has embraced the natural wine movement, offering a fantastic array of bars dedicated to showcasing sustainable, minimal-intervention wines in diverse and inviting settings.

picks.name: GlouGlou
picks.whyItMadeTheList: GlouGlou is widely considered the pioneer of natural wine bars in Amsterdam, offering an incredible selection of organic, biodynamic, and minimal-intervention wines. Its cozy, bustling atmosphere, complete with communal tables and a relaxed vibe, makes it perfect for both seasoned natural wine drinkers and curious newcomers. The staff are exceptionally knowledgeable and eager to guide you through their ever-changing list.
picks.whatToOrder: Any glass recommended by the sommelier, paired with their excellent artisanal cheese board.
picks.insiderTip: Go early or be prepared to stand, especially on weekends, as it's a popular spot. They also have a small selection of bottles to take home.
picks.redditQuote: "GlouGlou is my go-to for natural wine in Amsterdam. Always a great vibe and the staff really know their stuff. Love just chilling there with friends."

picks.name: Bar Centraal
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bar Centraal offers a dynamic dining and drinking experience focused on natural wines and delicious, seasonal small plates. The interior is chic yet unpretentious, with a lively open kitchen that adds to the buzzing atmosphere. Their wine list is extensive, featuring exciting discoveries from across Europe, all carefully selected for their natural characteristics.
picks.whatToOrder: A bottle of orange wine from their rotating list, accompanied by their seasonal tartare or a shared plate of grilled vegetables.
picks.insiderTip: They also have a fantastic lunch menu, which is often less crowded than dinner. Reservations are highly recommended for dinner, especially on weekends.
picks.redditQuote: "Bar Centraal is more than just a wine bar, their food is genuinely amazing and complements the natural wines perfectly. A must-visit!"

picks.name: Alex + Pinard
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Alex + Pinard brings a touch of Parisian charm to Amsterdam East, specializing in natural wines and classic bistro fare with a modern twist. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it perfect for an evening with friends or a casual date. Their wine list features a curated selection of mostly French natural wines, with knowledgeable staff ready to share their passion.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of Gamay or Chenin Blanc from their natural wine selection, alongside their steak frites or a daily special.
picks.insiderTip: They have a lovely outdoor terrace perfect for warmer evenings. Don't hesitate to ask for recommendations; the staff are incredibly passionate about their wines.
picks.redditQuote: "Finally found a great natural wine spot in Oost! Alex + Pinard has such a good vibe and the food is surprisingly delicious. Totally recommend their orange wine selection."

picks.name: Fiaschetteria Pura
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Fiaschetteria Pura offers an authentic Italian natural wine bar experience, focusing on small producers and biodynamic wines from Italy. It's a charming, intimate spot where you can enjoy excellent wines by the glass or bottle, paired with delicious Italian small bites and panini. The atmosphere is warm and unpretentious, feeling like a little slice of Italy in Amsterdam.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of natural Sangiovese or a sparkling Lambrusco, accompanied by a selection of their artisanal bruschetta or a fresh panini.
picks.insiderTip: This is a great spot for an aperitivo before dinner or a casual lunch. Their prices are very reasonable for the quality, making it a budget-friendly gem.
picks.redditQuote: "Fiaschetteria Pura is my secret natural wine spot in De Pijp. It's small but mighty, with super friendly staff and amazing Italian snacks. Their prices are unbeatable."

picks.name: Troef
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Troef is a contemporary restaurant and wine bar known for its modern Dutch cuisine and extensive natural wine list. Located in a beautifully renovated space, it offers a sophisticated yet comfortable environment. The focus is on seasonal ingredients and innovative dishes that pair wonderfully with their carefully curated selection of natural and biodynamic wines from both local and international producers.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask for their daily natural wine pairing with one of their inventive seasonal main courses, or a selection of smaller dishes.
picks.insiderTip: Troef also functions as a bottle shop, so if you fall in love with a particular wine, you might be able to take a bottle home. Book ahead, especially for dinner.
picks.redditQuote: "Troef blew me away. The food is incredible, truly inventive, and their natural wine list is next level. Felt like a proper culinary experience."

picks.name: Café Binnenvisser
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Café Binnenvisser is a relaxed, vibrant spot combining a neighborhood cafe, a restaurant, and a fantastic natural wine bar. It's known for its laid-back atmosphere, friendly service, and a diverse menu of delicious, often plant-forward, dishes. Their natural wine selection is thoughtfully chosen, offering a mix of familiar and adventurous labels, making it a favorite among locals.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of Pet-Nat or a light-bodied red, paired with their homemade focaccia or a sharing platter of dips and vegetables.
picks.insiderTip: They often host DJs and events, giving it a lively evening buzz. Check their social media for upcoming happenings. It's a great place to spend a whole afternoon or evening.
picks.redditQuote: "Binnenvisser is such a gem! Always a good time, good music, and their natural wines are always interesting. Plus, their food is surprisingly good for a 'bar'."

picks.name: Wijnbar Paulus
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the picturesque Jordaan, Wijnbar Paulus offers a sophisticated yet inviting atmosphere for enjoying quality wines, with a significant emphasis on organic and biodynamic options, often falling into the natural wine category. It's a cozy, intimate spot perfect for a quiet evening or a romantic date. The staff are passionate and provide excellent guidance through their curated list of European wines.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask the knowledgeable staff for a recommendation from their natural wine selection, paired with their excellent truffle cheese or Iberian ham.
picks.insiderTip: This bar is smaller, so it's advisable to go during off-peak hours for a guaranteed seat. It's also a great place to discover lesser-known European appellations.
picks.redditQuote: "Wijnbar Paulus in Jordaan is super underrated. They have some fantastic natural wines if you ask, and the atmosphere is just perfect for a relaxed evening."

picks.name: Raval
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Raval is a vibrant Spanish tapas bar and restaurant that boasts an impressive natural wine list alongside its delicious, authentic dishes. The atmosphere is lively and buzzing, evoking the spirit of Barcelona. Their wine selection thoughtfully complements the robust flavors of Catalan cuisine, featuring many organic and biodynamic Spanish wines that fit the natural profile.
picks.whatToOrder: A crisp, natural white wine from Catalonia, paired with their patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, and a selection of charcuterie.
picks.insiderTip: Raval is perfect for a lively group dinner. They don't take reservations for small groups, so be prepared for a short wait during peak hours. Try their vermouth too!
picks.redditQuote: "Raval's tapas are amazing, but their natural wine selection is what keeps me coming back. Always find something interesting to pair with the food, love the vibe there."

picks.name: Nela
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nela is a stylish new addition to Amsterdam's natural wine scene, offering a modern setting with a focus on seasonal Mediterranean-inspired dishes and an extensive list of natural and low-intervention wines. The interior is bright and airy, making it a great spot for both a refined meal and simply enjoying a unique bottle. Their knowledgeable staff are excellent guides to their evolving wine program.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their lesser-known natural skin-contact wines, accompanied by a small plate like their fresh burrata or a vegetable-focused dish.
picks.insiderTip: Nela often hosts special tasting events with winemakers, so keep an eye on their social media. It's a bit further out, but well worth the trip for serious wine lovers.
picks.redditQuote: "Heard about Nela and finally checked it out. The natural wine list is incredible, really well-curated, and the food matches the quality. A definite new favorite!"

picks.name: Rayleigh & Ramsay Pijp
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Rayleigh & Ramsay offers a unique self-service wine experience, allowing you to sample a vast array of wines, including many natural and biodynamic options, using a top-up card. Their De Pijp location is particularly popular for its lively atmosphere and comfortable setting. It's a fantastic way to explore different wines at your own pace, with knowledgeable staff on hand for advice if needed.
picks.whatToOrder: Explore a flight of natural wines via their dispensing machines. Try a few different orange wines or lesser-known varietals.
picks.insiderTip: Start with a small amount on your card and top up as you go. This allows you to try many different wines without committing to a full glass. Perfect for groups with varying tastes.
picks.redditQuote: "Love Rayleigh & Ramsay for trying new wines. Their natural selection is surprisingly good, and I always discover something new. Great for a casual hang out."

picks.name: Vleck Food & Wine
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Vleck Food & Wine provides a refined yet welcoming experience in the heart of Amsterdam, with a strong focus on natural, organic, and biodynamic wines. While it's primarily a restaurant, its dedication to its wine program makes it a significant player in the natural wine scene. The menu offers beautifully prepared seasonal dishes designed to complement their unique wine selection.
picks.whatToOrder: Allow the sommelier to suggest a natural wine pairing for one of their exquisite seasonal main courses or share several smaller, complex dishes.
picks.insiderTip: Vleck offers a daily changing menu, ensuring fresh and seasonal ingredients. It’s ideal for a slightly more upscale natural wine experience, so consider making a reservation.
picks.redditQuote: "Vleck is amazing if you want a really good dinner with an equally amazing natural wine list. The staff are super passionate and their pairings are always spot on."

picks.name: Le Forel
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Forel is a charming and relatively new establishment in the Jordaan, quickly gaining a reputation for its focus on natural wines and exquisite seafood-centric small plates. The atmosphere is intimate and stylish, perfect for a refined yet relaxed evening. Their natural wine list is thoughtfully curated to perfectly complement the delicate flavors of their marine-inspired menu.
picks.whatToOrder: A crisp, mineral-driven natural white wine (like a Muscadet or Aligoté), paired with their fresh oysters or a plate of cured fish.
picks.insiderTip: Given its smaller size and growing popularity, making a reservation is highly recommended, especially on weekends. It's a great choice for seafood lovers and natural wine enthusiasts.
picks.redditQuote: "Just tried Le Forel for the first time and was seriously impressed. Their natural wine selection with the seafood is a match made in heaven. Definitely going back!"

faq.question: What is natural wine?
faq.answer: Natural wine is made with minimal intervention in both the vineyard and the winery. This typically means organic or biodynamic farming, no added yeasts, no fining or filtering, and very low (or no) added sulfites. The result is a wine that often expresses a unique terroir and can have a more 'funky' or 'lively' character compared to conventional wines.

faq.question: Is natural wine expensive in Amsterdam?
faq.answer: Prices for natural wine in Amsterdam are comparable to high-quality conventional wines. A glass can range from €7-12, while bottles typically start around €35-40 and go upwards. Many bars offer a good selection by the glass, allowing you to explore without committing to a full bottle, and some places like Fiaschetteria Pura offer more budget-friendly options.

faq.question: Are natural wine bars suitable for non-wine drinkers?
faq.answer: Many natural wine bars in Amsterdam, like Bar Centraal or Café Binnenvisser, also offer a selection of craft beers, artisanal spirits, and non-alcoholic options, making them suitable for mixed groups. Their lively atmospheres and delicious food menus also ensure a great experience for everyone, regardless of their drink choice.

faq.question: Do I need to make reservations at natural wine bars in Amsterdam?
faq.answer: For popular spots like GlouGlou or Bar Centraal, especially on weekends or evenings, reservations are highly recommended to secure a table. Some smaller, more casual bars might operate on a walk-in basis, but it's always wise to check their website or social media in advance to avoid disappointment.

faq.question: What kind of food can I expect at natural wine bars?
faq.answer: Most natural wine bars in Amsterdam offer a selection of small plates, often focusing on seasonal, local, and European-inspired ingredients that pair well with wine. You can expect charcuterie, cheese boards, fresh salads, inventive vegetable dishes, and sometimes more substantial bistro-style main courses. The food is typically designed to complement the unique profiles of natural wines.

faq.question: Can I buy bottles to take home from these bars?
faq.answer: Yes, many natural wine bars in Amsterdam also function as bottle shops, allowing you to purchase bottles to enjoy at home. Places like GlouGlou and Troef are known for this. It's a great way to take home a memory of your visit or to continue exploring natural wines beyond the bar experience.

methodology: Our selection for Amsterdam's best natural wine bars was meticulously curated through extensive local research, expert reviews, and current patron feedback. We prioritized venues known for their commitment to natural, biodynamic, and organic wines, alongside exceptional atmosphere and knowledgeable staff. Each bar was evaluated on its unique offerings, value, and overall customer experience to ensure a diverse and high-quality list.
